caption: Every enterprise carries applications it has already moved on from.
An AI program short on history.
Solix Application Retirement connects to ERP, mainframe, custom and SaaS applications, files and email.
Data moves into a governed Preservation Zone, checked against the source, with retention and legal hold from the day it lands.
Only then does the application go dark. Its licenses, its servers, its risk: gone for good.
Nothing it held is lost. Auditors get provable records.
Users get the reports they know.
With Solix Data Ask, people ask in plain English and get cited answers from the application's own Knowledge Graph.
Governed history, ready for your AI.
Retire the application. Keep every answer.
